title: On murmurations
summary: In the recent paper ``Murmurations", Zubrilina showed that the Fourier coefficients of modular forms follow a certain murmuration pattern. The proof given in ``Murmurations" proceeded by estimating the terms of the Skoruppa-Zagier trace formula. However, a few technical issues arise in the proof, including an omission of certain Chebyshev factors that arise in summations from the Skoruppa-Zagier trace formula. In this work, we address these issues to solidify the proof.
